name: fitmanager-motion
description: Vídeo de vendas do FitManager, renderizado com Remotion

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.jsx FitManager out/fitmanager.mp4 --browser-executable "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome"
scripts.still: remotion still src/index.jsx FitManager out/frame.png --browser-executable "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome"
scripts.render:reels: remotion render src/index.jsx Reels out/fitmanager-reels.mp4 --browser-executable "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome"
scripts.assets: rm -rf public/video public/exercises && cp -R ../web/public/video public/video && cp -R ../web/public/exercises public/exercises
